method.emotion: Rust galion-emotion fp32 SER neu/hap/ang/sad + A/V/D; threads=2; no int8
method.windows: originals split into equal-duration ~2.5s windows (Samantha 7, Jarvis 6); production lines equal-duration windows nearest 2.5s
method.probability_caveat: Model confidence/uncertainty, NOT literal emotion fractions. Sweet and playful are unavailable labels. Whole-file outputs are nonlinear and cannot be averaged into ground truth.
method.entropy: Shannon bits, maximum 2. Mean H measures within-window uncertainty, H(mean p)-mean H is temporal JS diversity.
method.variance: population variance across windows, unitless squared A probability scale. Production pooled variance includes between-line variability; within-line variance listed separately.
method.comparison_limit: Original recording and 12 rendered lines have different text/duration. Do not infer causal emotion accuracy from aggregate entropy; pre/post timbre is matched-waveform ablation.
method.pace: two independent syllable estimators; galion-emotion proxy and galion-artic values are not interchangeable; no transcript-derived words/s asserted.

selected_reference.algorithm: farthest pair + farthest-first SER/AVD/prosody diversity; chronological 2s excerpts; edge ramps only
selected_reference.promotion: OFF BY DEFAULT; requires per-voice WER/ECAPA validation
selected_reference.speaker_policy: caller MUST retain original speaker_embeddings and speaker_features; use montage only for audio_features/audio_tokens
